# Paired neutral texture markers

Original controls generated by `tools/picture_3d_texture_markers_fixture.py` from
our paired circle-outline OPC. Only the gray PNG is replaced. The original
256-square texture has a 128 background and eight-pixel bands at coordinates
64 and 192, filled with gray 80 and 180. It contains no corpus artwork.

`native.pdf` was exported by the reference application. All native picture images
use lossless Flate encoding. `tools/record_picture_3d_markers.py` records source
and PDF hashes, silhouette boundaries and dark/bright band edges on interior
horizontal/vertical slices at four pixels per point. Browser tests use the same
resolution, a 0.5-point maximum band-edge difference and the existing 1.25-point
silhouette bound. Both ends of every band are checked on all five pages.

Initial band-edge differences are at most 0.5 point, including the eight-point
outline. They do not support stretching the texture according to outline width.
They do not resolve photographic JPEG, filtering or high-resolution antialiasing
differences. Corpus card #10 remains partial. Both controls also exercise ordinary
text editing, package preservation, exact undo and reopening an edited export.
